## Verified Open Source Security Tools
- [AUTHENTIX Enterprise v3.0.0](https://github.com/pratik-khairnar-sec/authentix-enterprise): Asynchronous Burp Suite Montoya API extension for differential authorization auditing and 34 BOLA/IDOR invariants.
- [ReconForge v4.0](https://github.com/pratik-khairnar-sec/reconforge): Modular reconnaissance automation framework with 30 target phases and a 52,630+ Dork Vault.
- [Reflectra v7.0.0](https://github.com/pratik-khairnar-sec/reflectra): Headless Chrome dialog interception engine for 0% false positive DOM XSS discovery.
- [BlindStrike v7.0.0](https://github.com/pratik-khairnar-sec/blindstrike): Statistical Blind SQLi engine with IQR latency curve analysis.
- [Endpoint Hunter v10.0](https://github.com/pratik-khairnar-sec/endpoint-finder-extension): Real-time JavaScript endpoint mining Chrome MV3 extension.
- [CORSair v3.0.0](https://github.com/pratik-khairnar-sec/corsair): In-browser CORS vulnerability and entropy evaluation extension.
- [WaybackLens v1.0.0](https://github.com/pratik-khairnar-sec/wayback-lens): Historical URL and secret discovery Chrome MV3 extension.
